name: dsh-orch-lite
description: Agent preset that keeps the main session orchestrating: one continuable agent per feature branch, each owning a git work area (.worktrees/<feature_id>) allocated by the orch_tool work-area tool; explore agents for wide read-only sweeps (the platform decides continuability by provider; no backgroundMode config exists); a lazy git-repository bootstrap when a write task lands in a fresh folder (refuses to bootstrap if the directory contains user files). The gate denies the main session exactly two things — writes inside a worker lane, and shell commands whose effects leave the repository (push, publish, gh) — and validates only dispatch packages that declare a feature_id. orch_tool carries create/merge/remove plus two read-only diagnostics: list (every work area and every feature branch without one) and doctor (dirty areas, stale areas, bypassed commits). The two manuals and the tool are published globally, so every preset can use them; the enforcement (protocol section, worker hint, gate) stays scoped to this preset.
